name: Film Leader
description: A clock hand sweeps the first clip away to reveal a scratched film countdown, with crosshair rings and big numbers counting down, each sweep wiping in the next one, and the last sweep reveals the second clip in its wake. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: count
params.description: Number of numbers counted down before the second clip

params.name: wear
params.description: Amount of film wear on the countdown: grain, scratches, dust and flicker

params.name: ink_color
params.description: Color of the numbers, rings, crosshair and clock hand
